#2 Just to clarify, this is not a “statement” but an analogy (explicitly marked as such) that I offer as an attempt to explain to mathematicians, and by comparison to a familar situation, what it means to expect a theory to exist, as yet unknown but with limiting cases that are known.

As it goes with analogies, if it helps you are welcome, while if it does not help you are free to ignore it. But as far as analogies, go, this one is rather apt, it seems to me.
